name: print-social-repeating-sale-banner-with-gummy-ring
title: Cobalt sale banner with ring of gummies and repeating pixel-type discount
whatItIs: A wide cobalt banner. At left, a teal tub shape; centre, a ring of glossy gummies and a slice of orange around 'Flavor Favorites' in serif; at right, three lines '52% OFF' in alternating green and pink pixel numerals with 'EVERYTHING' in white serif below.
whatItMeans: Bright, rhythmic and impossible to miss; repeating the offer makes it feel like a chant.
techniques: Repeat the key offer three times with alternating colours.
Combine pixel-style figures with classic serif.
Arrange the product in a ring around a label.
Animate items rotating for a lively loop.

vocabulary.definition: Saying the same phrase several times for emphasis.
Numbers drawn as a blocky pixel font.
Items arranged in a circle around text.
Mixing classic and digital type styles.
